notes:
1.2.0: new Settings layout, Settings at the top right, long-press and pencil to select

- Settings button sits at the top right next to the light/dark switch (phone, tablet and PC)
- Settings redesigned: left list of sections with the chosen one on the right on PC and tablets;
  on phones a list of sections (with a short summary each) that opens one page at a time, with Back
- Phone/tablet: long-press a task or routine to start selecting (then tap more, Mark done or Delete)
- PC: a small pencil next to each task and routine starts selecting with that item
- 'Select tasks & routines' removed from More
- Phone header tightened so All, PhD and Personal fit beside the two buttons
